name: Arabic-Nougat
description: A suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. Building on Meta's Nougat architecture, Arabic-Nougat includes three specialized models: arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, and arabic-large-nougat. These models are fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.

creator.name: Mohamed A. Rashad
creator.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering Ain Shams University, Cairo, Egypt

citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1 [cs.CL], 2024.
rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset used for training, arabic-img2md, contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs, and extracted Markdown text.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content from the Hindawi website was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired samples.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content was scraped from the Hindawi website, converted it to PDFs, and extracted Markdown text to generate paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of synthetic paired samples generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. No manual annotation was performed.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The models contribute to the broader field of document parsing and promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic. The release of arabic-books, a 1.1 billion-token dataset extracted from Arabic literature, provides a valuable resource for future research in Arabic NLP and OCR.
rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. Expanding the dataset to include diverse genres and styles is critical for improving model robustness.
rai:dataLimitations: The arabic-img2md dataset may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text beyond the Hindawi web content. The models exhibit hallucination issues in arabic-small-nougat and repetition issues in larger models. Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts, such as those containing dense tables, charts, or images, may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations. The computational resources required for training arabic-large-nougat are significant. Performance on multilingual documents or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested.
rai:dataUseCases: Training: The arabic-img2md dataset was exclusively used to train arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat. Testing: A test set of 160 random, unseen Arabic book pages from arabic-img2md was used for evaluation. Usage Guidelines: For practical applications, arabic-base-nougat is recommended for general text extraction tasks and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents. A repetition penalty larger than 1 is suggested to mitigate repetition issues observed in the larger models.
